messages.author: c7939ba845c5770f
messages.subject: Java version 1.8?
parts:
First of all, I must say I am super excited about the prospects of R shiny. Super work, guys! 

I am currently working on an app where I want to use the RDAVIDWebService package. However, it requires Java 1.8. A very simple shiny app shows that the version is 1.7 (https://rmtrane.shinyapps.io/javainfo). The server.R file is 

library(rJava)

shinyServer <- function(input,output){
    .jinit()
    output$javainfo <- renderText({
        .jcall("java/lang/System", "S", "getProperty", "java.runtime.version")
    })
}
 
and ui.R file

shinyUI(fluidPage(
    mainPanel(verbatimTextOutput("javainfo"))
))

Is there any way to use java version 1.8 with R Shiny? 

Sincerely,
Ralph

You will likely need to re-deploy your application in order to pick up the change.
